svg.text: Channel name: name chips in text order; drag to reorder, ✕ takes one out, right click splits.
Axis: the chip that says X, Y or Z. + Pick arms the slot.
Order: a chip with the order number, or one number typed for all.
Metadata: a text turned into a field of the channel, e.g. Damping = 0.02.
Hint: which channel the slots show and what a click in the preview does (Esc stops picking).
Click a header cell, or the Sheet / File / Folder text above, to offer its chips; each role has its colour band.
Colours of the roles; the selected channel is marked blue.
What the roles make of every channel; click a row to select that channel. Problem shows what fails.
